, Reason for Mistake: They conflated total winners with unique winners and used the wrong timeframe. They cited “46 winners” (a later total and not unique winners) instead of 42 unique Survivor winners as of Season 44, and assumed American Idol had 24 winners by 2025 rather than aligning to the same cutoff (21 by mid-2023).
